description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics covered in a dataset used for evaluating large language models, specifically focusing on attribution. The chart contains 13 slices, each representing a different topic category. The slices are labeled as follows: Business (blue, 5.9%), Geography (light blue, 2.7%), Math (yellow, 1.2%), Game&Anime (orange, 8.2%), History (red, 8.2%), Law (purple, 5.1%), Science (pink, 6.7%), Fin (light pink, 6.3%), Daily Life (green, 7.1%), Pet & Animal (dark green, 5.5%), Med & Health (teal, 6.7%), and AI/NLP Resources (grey, 24.3%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending by proportion, with AI/NLP Resources being the largest and Math being the smallest. A legend is present, listing each topic and its corresponding color.
